questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code maps failures and outcomes to HTTP status codes and error responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Author B has blocked viewer A. A requests GET /v1/posts/<id> for a public post by B that exists and is not deleted. What does A see?
choices: 404 post_not_found, identical to a post that does not exist

questions.prompt: The author sends DELETE for their own post twice in a row (for example after a network retry). What do the two calls return?
A client calls GET /v1/feed with If-None-Match set to the ETag it received earlier, and the viewer's feed has not changed. What is returned?
choices: 200 with the full item list and the same ETag
304 with no body and the ETag header
